pr.title: chore(mcp): remove residual exa references (ADR-223 cleanup)
pr.body: Finishes the exa retirement started by ADR-223 (docs/90-adr/adr-223-retire-exa-mcp-server.md, commit 65313194a) which already removed exa from the canonical fleet catalog and added dead-surface CI assertions in tests/arch/test_mcp_fleet_catalog_contract.py. This packet closes the remaining decisions-ledger.md item ('exa: retire, already shipped in #1002') by deleting the stale exa entries still present in scripts/mcp/wire_claude_mcp.py, scripts/utilities/fix_mcp_config.py, docker/mcp-servers-source/start-all-mcp-servers.sh, docker/mcp-servers-source/services/mcp-client/main.py, and scripts/ui/tmux_metamcp_controller.py, none of which are covered by the existing CI dead-surface grep because they are legacy scripts outside the catalog's own generated-output check.
